other_conditions: The Handicrafts Society must be registered either as a Co‑operative society or under the Societies Act.
Members of the society must be artisans approved by the State Government or the Development Commissioner (Handicrafts).
The Society must exclusively deal with handicraft products produced by artisans of the Union Territory of Puducherry.
benefits_summary: Grants are provided to eligible Handicrafts Societies for conducting exhibitions, with up to ₹10,00,000 per annum for a designated society and ₹2,00,000 per annum for other societies.
documents_required: Prescribed format of the application form
Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested, if required)
